blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Balancing performance trade-offs on long-tailed data distributions remains a long-standing challenge in visual recognition. Existing methods mainly improve tail classes through re-balancing, representation learning, or data augmentation, but the underlying cause of tail class degradation is still insufficiently explored. In this paper, we find that standard long-tailed training induces background-biased representation and optimization: tail classes suffer larger background distribution shifts and become increasingly driven by background gradients. This reveals that tail degradation is not merely caused by insufficient samples, but also by the learning of irrelevant background features. To tackle this issue, we propose Object-Focused Background Debiasing (OFBD), a framework that mitigates background bias from both distribution and optimization perspectives. Specifically, Foreground-guided CutMix preserves target-related foregrounds while diversifying complementary backgrounds, and Background-guided Feature Rectification suppresses background-biased features without learnable parameters or additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method improves overall accuracy, achieves significant tail-class gains, and can serve as a plug-in for mainstream long-tailed methods without external data or pretrained recognition models. The code is available at: https://ofbd-neurips2026-longtail-learning.github.io/
blocks.zh: 在长尾数据分布上平衡性能取舍,仍然是视觉识别方面长期存在的挑战. 现有方法主要通过再平衡,表现学习,或数据增强来改进尾巴类,但尾巴类退化的根本原因仍未得到充分的探索. 在本文中,我们发现标准长尾训练诱发了背景偏颇的表述和优化:尾班经历更大的背景分布变化并日益被背景梯度所驱动. 这揭示出尾巴退化不仅是由样本不足所引起,也是由学习不相干的背景特征所引起. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用有目标背景的Debiasing(OFBD),这个框架从分布和优化的角度减轻背景偏差。 具体地说,前地导CutMix保留了与目标相关的前地,同时使互补背景多样化,而后地导地物校正压制了背景偏重的特征,而没有可学习的参数或额外的培训. 广泛的实验显示,我们的方法可以提高整体准确性,实现重大的尾等增益,并且可以充当主流长尾方法的插件,而无需外部数据或预先训练的识别模型. 该守则可在以下网站查阅:https://ofbd-neurips2026-长尾-学习.github.io/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The prevailing paradigms in visual recognition [ 37 , 80 , 16 ] owe much of their success to large-scale, carefully curated datasets [ 66 , 47 ] with balanced class distributions. However, real-world data naturally exhibits highly imbalanced or long-tailed distributions [ 97 ] . When optimized on such skewed distributions, standard training protocols inevitably become biased toward data-abundant head classes, resulting in severe performance degradation on data-scarce tail classes.
blocks.zh: 视觉识别中流行的范式[37,80,16]在很大程度上归功于大规模,精心整理的数据集[66,47] 与均衡的类分布. 然而,现实世界数据自然显示出高度不平衡或长尾分布[97]. 在优化这种扭曲的分布时,标准训练协议不可避免地偏向于数据丰富的头级课程,导致数据稀缺尾级的性能严重退化。

blocks.en: Existing methods addressing the class imbalance issue mainly fall into three paradigms. First, class re-balancing strategies such as resampling [ 50 , 60 ] or reweighting [ 21 , 11 ] , amplify tail signals but may overfit tail classes [ 74 ] . Second, architectural improvements correct feature and classifier bias via contrastive representation learning [ 110 , 83 , 32 ] ; and via logit calibration [ 53 ] or expert routing [ 87 , 9 , 100 ] . Third, information augmentation techniques synthesize or transfer semantic variations for tail classes [ 84 , 70 ] , beyond conventional augmentations [ 1 ] ( e.g. , cropping, flipping). Despite these improvements, existing methods mainly compensate for data quantity, leaving the degradation of tail representations during standard optimization [ 40 ] largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: 解决阶级不平衡问题的现有方法主要分为三个范式. 首先,重制[50,60]或重制[21,11]等分级再平衡策略,扩大尾部信号,但可能过于适应尾部等级[74]. 第二,建筑改进通过对比性表现学习[110,83,32];通过登录校正[53]或专家路线[87,9,100],正确特征和分类偏差. 第三,信息增强技术合成或转移了尾等[84,70]的语义变化,超出了常规增强[1](如收割,翻转等). 尽管有这些改进,但现有方法主要补偿了数据数量,使得在标准优化过程中尾端表示的退化[40]基本上没有被探讨.

blocks.en: Interestingly, recent advances in self-supervised [ 28 , 49 ] and few-shot learning [ 88 ] demonstrate that models can learn highly transferable representations from extremely limited data [ 15 ] . Such findings indicate that sample scarcity alone is insufficient to explain the profound representational collapse observed in tail classes. This paradox raises a critical question: If limited data is not an inherent barrier, why do long-tailed models fail to capture the discriminative features of tail classes?
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,最近自我监督[28,49]和少许快活学习[88]的进步表明,模型可以从极其有限的数据中学习高度可转移的表示[15]. 这些调查结果表明,单是样本缺乏不足以解释尾巴类中观察到的深度代表性倒塌。 这一悖论提出了一个关键问题: 如果有限的数据不是一个固有的障碍,那么为什么长尾模型不能捕捉尾巴类的区别特征?

blocks.en: To investigate the underlying mechanism, we visualize the spatial representations learned by representative long-tailed networks [ 53 , 110 ] . As illustrated in Fig. 1 (c), we observe a striking phenomenon: standard imbalanced training severely compromises the spatial inductive bias of the network, causing it to co-activate target foregrounds with irrelevant background regions. This empirical evidence reveals that tail-class degradation extends beyond simple data scarcity; crucially, it induces a profound background bias in both representation and optimization. Consequently, discriminative foreground features are marginalized by spurious contextual cues, leading to degradation on tail classes [ 77 , 55 ] . Therefore, resolving the long-tailed dilemma necessitates a dual approach: enhancing target-related foreground while explicitly suppressing the exploitation of irrelevant background evidence.
blocks.zh: 为了调查基本机制,我们将代表性长尾网络[53,110]所学到的空间表现可视化. 如图1(c)所示,我们观察到一个引人注目的现象:标准不平衡的培训严重损害了网络的空间诱导偏差,使其与无关的背景区域共同激活目标前景。 这一经验证据表明,尾等降解超越了简单的数据稀缺;关键是,它会引起在代表性和优化方面的深刻背景偏差。 因此,歧视性前景特征被虚假的背景提示所边缘化,导致尾巴类退化[77、55]。 因此,要解决长期存在的两难局面,就必须采取双重办法:加强目标相关前景,同时明确禁止利用不相干的背景证据。

blocks.en: Suppressing irrelevant background evidence requires understanding its entanglement with targets. Building upon recent insights [ 55 , 73 ] , we attribute this background bias to two structural forms of input-level co-occurrence: object-scene ( e.g. , fish with water) and object-object ( e.g. , racket with person) entanglements (Fig. 1 (a)). These co-occurrences bias optimization toward spurious background shortcuts, resulting in background-biased representations and skewed BG feature distributions (Fig. 1 (b)). We formalize this contextual and structural analysis in Sec. 3 . Although spatial mixup strategies like CutMix [ 98 ] can disrupt these co-occurrences, prior works have shown that naive random replacements may introduce irrelevant noise [ 58 , 29 ] . To tackle this issue, we propose Object-Focused Background Debiasing (OFBD), a framework that mitigates background bias from both distribution and optimization perspectives. Specifically, Foreground-guided CutMix (FG-CutMix) uses a reinforcement-learning selector to handle discrete and non-differentiable region selection, preserving target-related foregrounds while replacing backgrounds to break foreground-background co-occurrence. Meanwhile, Background-guided Feature Rectification (BFR) estimates background contribution from channel-wise feature statistics and down-weights background-biased spatial features in a parameter-free manner, avoiding head-class-dominated learnable rectification.
blocks.zh: 压制不相干的背景证据需要了解其与目标的纠缠. 基于最近的见解[55,73],我们把这种背景偏差归因于两种结构形式的输入级共聚物:物体-场景(例如有水的鱼)和物体-物体(例如同人打闹)缠绕(图1(a))。 这些并发现象向虚假背景快捷方式优化,导致背景偏颇的表述和BG特征分布扭曲(图1(b))。 我们将在第3节中正式确定这一背景和结构分析。 虽然CutMix [98]等空间相混策略可以打乱这些相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用有目标背景的Debiasing(OFBD),这个框架从分布和优化的角度减轻背景偏差。 具体来说,Foreground-guided CutMix(FG-CutMix)使用增强学习选择器来处理离散和无差异的区域选择,保留了与目标相关的前地,同时替换背景来打破前地-后地并发. 同时,由背景引导的地物校正(BFR)以无参数的方式估计出从频道地物统计和下重背景偏差空间地物的背景贡献,避免了由头等主修的可学习校正.

blocks.en: Overall, the main contributions of this paper are summarized as follows: • Novel Perspective: We systematically investigate the inherent background bias in long-tailed recognition. Through structural analysis and empirical validation, we reveal how this bias shifts feature distributions and misguides optimization dynamics. • Dual Debiasing Framework: We propose FG-CutMix and BFR to address the two biases. FG-CutMix integrates reinforcement learning [ 71 ] to preserve target foregrounds, while BFR rectifies features to reduce background reliance in a parameter-free manner. • Superior Performance & Plug-and-Play Versatility: Extensive experiments demonstrate that without relying on external data or pretrained vision models, OFBD significantly boosts tail-class performance and overall accuracy. Furthermore, it inherently serves as a highly efficient plug-in module for existing mainstream long-tailed models.
blocks.zh: • 小说视角: 我们系统地调查长期认识中固有的背景偏见。 通过结构分析和经验验证,我们揭示了这种偏差如何改变分布特征和错误引导优化动态. • 双重禁忌框架: 我们建议FG-CutMix和BFR解决这两个偏差. FG-CutMix整合了增强学习[71]来保存目标前缘,而BFR则会重新调整特性来以无参数的方式减少背景依赖. • 高级性能和插管 偏差 : 广泛的实验表明,在不依赖外部数据或预先训练好的视觉模型的情况下,OFBD能大大提高尾等性能和整体准确性. 此外,它从本质上来说是现有主流长尾模型的一个高效插件模块。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Long-tailed Learning: Real-world data are often long-tailed [ 11 , 111 , 57 , 45 , 21 ] . Existing methods include class re-balancing [ 21 , 102 , 50 , 65 , 75 ] , information augmentation [ 70 , 41 , 48 , 91 , 104 ] , and architectural improvements [ 24 , 13 , 68 , 93 , 76 ] . Yet they mainly compensate class quantity: re-balancing changes sample/loss weights, augmentation adds diversity without separating foreground features from background features, and architectures rarely rectify feature-level background bias. We instead mitigate distribution- and optimization-level background bias by decoupling target-related foreground features from spurious background features.
blocks.zh: 长尾学习: 现实世界的数据往往有长尾[11,111,57,45,21]. 现有方法包括班级再平衡[21,102,50,65,75],信息增强[70,41,48,91,104],以及建筑改进[24,13,68,93,76]. 然而它们主要补偿类数量:再平衡变化样本/损失权重,增强增加多样性而不将前地特征与背景特征相分离,而建筑很少纠正地物级背景偏差. 相反,我们通过将目标相关前地特征与虚假后地特征脱钩来减少分布和优化层面的背景偏好。

blocks.en: Background Bias in Visual Recognition: Deep neural networks are notoriously prone to background bias, often relying on spurious contextual correlations (shortcuts) rather than intrinsic object semantics [ 18 , 17 , 95 , 56 ] . While various debiasing strategies have been proposed [ 54 , 82 , 34 , 38 , 5 ] , they predominantly assume balanced data distributions, leaving their behavior under severe class imbalance unexplored. Our work bridges this critical gap by revealing that standard long-tailed optimization inherently exacerbates these background biases. In response, we introduce a dual debiasing framework, offering a principled approach to robust and unbiased long-tailed recognition.
blocks.zh: 视觉识别中的背景偏见 : 深层神经网络臭名昭著地容易出现背景偏差,经常依赖虚假的上下文关联(shortcut)而不是内在的物体语义[18,17,95,56]. 虽然提出了各种去偏差策略[54,82,34,38,5],但主要假设数据分布平衡,使得他们在严重阶级不平衡下的行为得不到探讨. 我们的工作弥补了这一重大差距,揭示了标准的长期优化必然会加剧这些背景偏见。 作为回应,我们引入了双重脱轨框架,为有力和无偏见的长期承认提供了一个原则性办法。

blocks.en: RL-driven Data Augmentation: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been used to search augmentation policies [ 10 , 46 , 84 ] , select transformation operations or magnitudes [ 19 , 12 ] , and identify informative regions [ 89 , 90 , 44 ] . These methods optimize validation performance, augmentation strength, or region informativeness for general robustness, but are not tailored to long-tailed recognition, where tail classes are more vulnerable to spurious background reliance. In contrast, our RL selector is designed for FG-CutMix under long-tailed training. By selecting foreground regions that preserve target semantics after background replacement, the selector disrupts foreground-background co-occurrence and reduces tail-class background reliance.
blocks.zh: RL 驱动数据增强 : 强化学习(RL)被用于搜索增强政策[10,46,84],选择转化操作或规模[19,12],并找出信息化区域[89,90,44]. 这些方法优化了验证性能,增强强度,或区域信息化,以达到一般的稳健性,但并不适应于长尾识别,而尾等更易受到虚假背景依赖. 相比之下,我们的RL选择器是在长尾训练下为FG-CutMix设计的. 通过选择在背景替换后保留目标语义的前地区域,选择器会干扰前地-后地并发,并减少尾等背景依赖.

blocks.en: 3 Analysis and Motivation
blocks.zh: 3. 分析和动力

blocks.en: In this section, we analyze background bias from two complementary perspectives and provide empirical evidence. At the distribution level, we study how the learned background feature distribution deviates from that of the full balanced dataset. At the optimization level, we examine how training becomes increasingly driven by background-related gradients.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们从两个互补的角度分析背景偏差,并提供经验证据。 在分布层面,我们研究所学背景特征分布如何偏离完全平衡数据集。 在优化层面,我们研究了培训如何日益由背景梯度驱动。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Guided by Sec. 3 , our framework addresses background bias from two aspects. FG-CutMix targets the distribution-level shift Δ ​ D b ​ g \Delta D_{bg} by preserving foregrounds while replacing backgrounds. BFR targets the optimization-level shift Δ ​ R t \Delta R_{t} by down-weighting background-biased features. Together, they mitigate biased background distributions and background-driven optimization in long-tailed training. We provide a theoretical interpretation of the effectiveness of both modules in Appendix B.4 .

blocks.en: 4.1 Foreground-guided CutMix
blocks.zh: 4.1 前景导断

blocks.en: Unlike naive CutMix, which may exacerbate bias by sampling background-only regions [ 55 ] , our Foreground-guided CutMix (FG-CutMix) explicitly preserves target foregrounds. Furthermore, its RL-based selector introduces minimal computational overhead, ensuring practicality for large-scale training. Detailed experiments evaluating the computational cost are provided in Appendix D.8 .
blocks.zh: 与天真的CutMix(英语:CutMix (film CutMix))不同的是,它可能通过采样仅以背景为主的区域来加剧偏差[55],而我们的前地导取的CutMix(英语:FG-CutMix)明确保留了目标前地. 此外,其基于RL的筛选器引入了最低限度的计算间接费用,确保了大规模培训的实用性。 附录D.8提供了评估计算成本的详细实验。

blocks.en: 4.1.1 RL-based Foreground Region Selection
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 基于RL的展望区域选择

blocks.en: The key challenge in FG-CutMix is selecting foreground regions effective for background replacement. CAM-based [ 106 , 31 ] and SAM-based [ 35 , 64 ] strategies can localize complete foregrounds, but accurate localization may not yield the best mixing region. Since CutMix benefits from partial-view recognition and regional perturbation [ 98 ] , effective regions should balance target preservation and background replacement, as overly complete regions may weaken background variation and regularization. Since foreground-region selection is discrete and non-differentiable, we use an RL-based selector to learn an adaptive policy, capture class-specific foreground importance.
blocks.zh: FG-CutMix的关键挑战是选择有效的前景区域来替换背景. 基于CAM的[106,31]和基于SAM的[35,64]策略可以将完整的前地本地化,但准确本地化可能不会产生最好的混合区域. 由于CutMix得益于部分视图识别和区域扰动[98],有效的区域应平衡目标保存和背景替换,因为过于完整的区域可能削弱背景差异和规范化。 由于前地-区域选择是离散的且无差别的,我们使用基于RL的选择器来学习适应性政策,捕捉特定阶级的前地重要性.

blocks.en: 4.2 Background-guided Feature Rectification
blocks.zh: 4.2 背景特征校正

blocks.en: Although FG-CutMix alleviates distribution-level background bias by restoring background diversity, optimization may still favor irrelevant background cues that are easier to exploit than sparse tail-class foreground evidence. We therefore introduce Background-guided Feature Rectification (BFR), which uses background-aware scores to down-weight biased feature locations in the final representation. To avoid head-class-dominated gradients from learnable parameters, BFR is strictly parameter-free. Inspired by SimAM [ 96 ] and LaSt-ViT [ 73 ] , BFR estimates foreground contribution from channel-wise feature statistics: larger normalized deviations from stable channel means indicate higher foreground contribution. Effective channel aggregation further prevents sparse tail-class foreground channels from being diluted and derives background-aware scores for rectification.
blocks.zh: 虽然FG-CutMix通过恢复背景多样性来缓解分布级背景偏差,但优化仍然可能倾向于不相干的背景提示,这些提示比稀有的尾等前缘证据更容易被利用. 因此,我们引入了由背景指导的地物校正(BFR),在最终代表中将背景感分数用于下重偏差地物位置. 为从可学习参数中避免以头等为主的梯度,BFR严格来说是无参数的. 在SimAM [96]和LaSt-ViT [73]的启发下,BFR估计了从频道特有统计中得出的前地贡献: 较大的常态偏差从稳定的频道表示中可以看出较高的前地贡献. 有效的通道聚合进一步防止了尾等前缘通道被稀释并获得背景认知分数进行校正.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experiment Setup

blocks.en: Datasets and Metrics. Our proposed framework is evaluated on four long-tailed benchmarks: CIFAR-10-LT [ 4 ] , CIFAR-100-LT [ 4 ] , ImageNet-LT [ 52 ] , and iNaturalist 2018 [ 79 ] . Following standard evaluation protocols [ 84 , 105 ] , we report Top-1 accuracy. For CIFAR datasets, we evaluate effectiveness of OFBD across three imbalance ratios ( r ∈ { 100 , 50 , 10 } r\in\{100,50,10\} ) and decompose results into “Many” ( > 100 >100 samples), “Med.” ( 20 ∼ 100 20\sim 100 ), and “Few” ( < 20 <20 ) categories for further analysis. For ImageNet-LT and iNaturalist 2018, we assess various backbones to verify architecture generality.
blocks.zh: 数据集与计量. 我们的拟议框架按四个长期基准进行评估: CIFAR-10-LT [4], CIFAR-100-LT [4], ImageNet-LT [52],和iNaturalist 2018 [79]. 按照标准评价协议[84,105],我们报告Top-1的准确性. 对于CIFAR数据集,我们评价了OFBD在三种不平衡比率(r {100,50,10}r\in {100,50,10\}})中的效力,并将结果分解为“许多”( > 100 > 100个样本)、“Med”(20 ∼100 20\sim 100)和“Few”( < 20 < 20)类,以便进一步分析。 对于ImageNet-LT和iNaturalist 2018,我们评估了各种骨干,以验证架构通俗.

blocks.en: Compared Methods. To demonstrate the effectiveness and plug-and-play versatility of OFBD, we integrate it into representative, open-source long-tailed methods to ensure reproducibility. These span standard training (CE), re-balancing techniques (LDAM-DRW [ 4 ] , BBN [ 107 ] ), contrastive learning (SBCL [ 22 ] , BCL [ 110 ] ), and advanced representation optimization (GBG [ 43 ] , MKP [ 8 ] ). By consistently using standard ResNet backbones, this integration fairly and directly validates OFBD’s ability to boost performance by mitigating background bias across diverse learning paradigms.
blocks.zh: 比较方法。 为了展示OFBD的有效性和插值与游戏多功能性,我们将其整合入具有代表性的开源长尾法,以确保可再生. 其中包括标准培训(CE)、再平衡技术(LDAM-DRW[4]、BBN[107])、对比性学习(SBCL[22]、BCL[110])和高级代表优化(GBG[43]、MKP[8])。 通过持续使用标准的ResNet主干网,这种集成公平而直接地验证了OFBD通过减少不同学习范式的背景偏差来提升性能的能力.

blocks.en: Implementation. For fairness, we reproduce baselines with official codes and fixed seeds. We use ResNet-32 for CIFAR10/100-LT [ 4 ] , ResNet-50 [ 20 ] for ImageNet-LT and iNaturalist 2018, and ViT-B/16 [ 14 ] for cross-architecture evaluation. All models are trained on an RTX 4090 GPU with a batch size of 256. For OFBD, we set λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 , γ = 0.8 \gamma=0.8 , α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 , and β = 0.02 \beta=0.02 across datasets. Extensive ablation studies, further analyses, and implementation details are deferred to Appendix D .

blocks.en: CIFAR100-LT and CIFAR10-LT [ 4 ] . Table 1 reports results on CIFAR-10/100-LT after integrating OFBD into existing methods. Across 42 experimental settings, OFBD improves 40 of them, with the largest gains of + 6.51 % +6.51\% on CIFAR-100-LT and + 3.88 % +3.88\% on CIFAR-10-LT. For the standard CE baseline, OFBD improves CIFAR-100-LT by + 6.51 % +6.51\% , + 3.85 % +3.85\% , and + 2.51 % +2.51\% under r = 100 r=100 , 50 50 , and 10 10 , respectively, and improves CIFAR-10-LT by + 3.88 % +3.88\% , + 3.86 % +3.86\% , and + 0.86 % +0.86\% . For re-balancing methods, OFBD improves LDAM-DRW by up to + 3.72 % +3.72\% and BBN by up to + 2.36 % +2.36\% on CIFAR-100-LT. For contrastive-learning methods, OFBD improves BCL and SBCL by up to + 2.35 % +2.35\% and + 1.99 % +1.99\% , respectively. For representation-optimization methods, OFBD improves GBG by up to + 2.31 % +2.31\% and MKP by + 1.21 % +1.21\% under high imbalance. These consistent gains verify the plug-in effectiveness of OFBD across diverse long-tailed learning paradigms.

blocks.en: In this section, we present key ablation and analysis experiments to characterize the effectiveness, design choices, and debiasing behavior of OFBD. More experiments are provided in Appendix D .

blocks.en: Component Analysis. We conduct component ablation on CIFAR100-LT ( r = 100 r=100 ) with ResNet-32. We choose CE and BCL [ 110 ] as representative baselines: CE reflects standard long-tailed training, while BCL represents a strong contrastive-learning baseline. As shown in Table 3 , adding the full FG-CutMix+BFR framework to CE improves the overall accuracy from 38.32 % 38.32\% to 44.83 % 44.83\% ( + 6.51 % +6.51\% ), mainly due to the large Few-class gain from 9.06 % 9.06\% to 23.93 % 23.93\% . On BCL, FG-CutMix and BFR improve the overall accuracy by + 1.54 % +1.54\% and + 1.13 % +1.13\% , respectively. Combining them further improves BCL from 51.84 % 51.84\% to 54.19 % 54.19\% ( + 2.35 % +2.35\% ), with Few-class accuracy increasing from 33.07 % 33.07\% to 40.34 % 40.34\% . These results show that both components are effective, especially for tail classes.

blocks.en: Analysis of RL-based foreground region selection. Built upon the BCL [ 110 ] , we further analyze the region selection strategy in FG-CutMix on CIFAR100-LT ( r = 100 r=100 ). As shown in Table 4 , standard CutMix with random regions achieves only 52.17 % 52.17\% , indicating that random replacement may preserve irrelevant backgrounds or discard target-related evidence. Using pretrained SAM- and CAM-based foreground regions selection improves the accuracy to 52.43 % 52.43\% and 52.63 % 52.63\% , respectively, but the gains remain limited. In contrast, our RL-based foreground regions selection achieves the best accuracy of 54.19 % 54.19\% , outperforming random, SAM-based, and CAM-based selection by + 2.02 % +2.02\% , + 1.76 % +1.76\% , and + 1.56 % +1.56\% , respectively. These results show that accurate foreground localization is not necessarily the most effective mixing strategy, while RL-based selection better balances target preservation and background replacement. Further ablation analysis is provided in Appendix D.7 .

blocks.en: Visualization of Background Debiasing. We further visualize whether OFBD reduces background-biased representation and optimization. As shown in Fig. 3(a) , CE predictions co-activate target foregrounds and surrounding backgrounds. With OFBD, attention becomes more object-focused, indicating reduced reliance on irrelevant background cues. Fig. 3(b) shows that CE produces a positive and increasing background-gradient-ratio shift, particularly for tail classes, while CE+OFBD suppresses this shift for both head and tail classes, especially for tail classes. Overall, these results confirm that OFBD successfully mitigates background bias, encouraging the model to focus more on target semantics rather than spurious background cues.

blocks.en: Background Score Validation. We evaluate whether B u B_{u} captures background-related information using CAM-guided SAM masks. Specifically, CAM responses from a pretrained classifier are used as point prompts for SAM to obtain foreground/background masks. As shown in Table 5 , B u B_{u} assigns higher average scores to background regions than foreground regions and achieves BG AUROC above 0.70 across all groups, demonstrating its ability to identify background-biased features.

blocks.en: Background Intervention. To verify whether OFBD reduces background shortcut reliance, we conduct intervention-based evaluations on ImageNet-LT [ 52 ] using foreground-only, background-only, and background-swapped inputs with fixed post-hoc foreground masks. As shown in Table 6 , OFBD improves FG-only accuracy by +1.81 points while reducing BG-only accuracy by 1.24 points, indicating a more object-focused representation. Moreover, it achieves a +7.02-point gain under BG-swap, demonstrating improved robustness against background bias under distribution shifts.

blocks.en: Foreground Selection Analysis. We compare the proposed RL-based foreground selector with representative mixing strategies, including SaliencyMix [ 78 ] , SnapMix [ 25 ] , PuzzleMix [ 33 ] , ResizeMix [ 62 ] , and Attentive CutMix [ 81 ] . As shown in Table 7 , the RL selector achieves the best overall accuracy and Few-shot performance, improving Few-shot accuracy by +5.20 points over the strongest heuristic baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of adaptive foreground preservation for long-tailed recognition. This improvement highlights the advantage of learning region selection over manually designed heuristic strategies.

As shown in Table 8 , OFBD consistently improves overall and Few-shot accuracy across different imbalance ratios. Specifically, OFBD improves overall accuracy by +0.90/+1.16/+1.17 points under r = 200 / 300 / 400 r=200/300/400 , while achieving +3.75/+3.50/+3.66 points gains on Few-shot classes. These results demonstrate that OFBD remains effective under increasingly challenging long-tailed distributions.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Revisiting long-tailed recognition via background bias, we reveal that tail degradation arises from sample scarcity combined with background-biased representation and optimization (i.e., larger distribution shifts and gradient reliance). To mitigate this, we propose Object-Focused Background Debiasing (OFBD), a plug-in framework. Specifically, FG-CutMix preserves target foregrounds while diversifying backgrounds, and parameter-free BFR suppresses background-biased features. Experiments across four datasets demonstrate that OFBD improves mainstream methods, boosting tail accuracy without sacrificing head performance on both CNN and Transformer backbones. Its plug-in design inspires extensions to other long-tailed tasks like object detection and trajectory prediction.
blocks.zh: 通过背景偏差对长尾部的识别进行重新审查,我们发现尾部退化源于样本稀缺,加上背景偏差的表述和优化(即更大的分布变化和梯度依赖)。 为了缓解这种情况,我们提议使用Object-Focid Base Debiasing(OFBD)作为插件框架。 具体来说,FG-CutMix在使背景多样化的同时保留了目标前景,而无参数的BFR压制了背景偏差特征. 跨越四个数据集的实验表明,OFBD改进了主流方法,提高了尾部精度而不会牺牲CNN和变形器主干线上的头部性能. 其插件设计启发了其他长尾任务如物体检测和轨迹预测的扩展.

blocks.en: OFBD is implemented as a plug-and-play module and can be integrated into various long-tailed recognition frameworks without altering their original backbones or classifier designs.

blocks.en: For CIFAR-10-LT and CIFAR-100-LT, we use ResNet-32 as the backbone. Models are trained for 200 epochs with a batch size of 256 using SGD with momentum 0.9 and weight decay 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} . The learning rate is linearly warmed up to 0.15 during the first 20 epochs and decayed by 0.1 at epochs 160 and 180. When OFBD is plugged into contrastive-learning baselines, e.g. , BCL [ 110 ] and SBCL [ 22 ] , we keep their original contrastive objectives unchanged. The projection dimension is 128, the contrastive temperature is 0.1, and the classification and contrastive losses are weighted by 2 and 0.6, following the original baseline settings [ 22 , 110 ] . For non-contrastive baselines, the projection head and contrastive loss are removed.

This bound indicates that larger background distribution deviation can increase the possible magnitude of background feature shift, which supports the hypothesis in Eq. 1 . In particular, since tail classes have fewer samples, their empirical background distributions can deviate more from the balanced reference, potentially leading to larger background-biased feature shifts compared with head classes. Hence, this motivates a targeted debiasing mechanism for tail classes, as standard empirical risk minimization (ERM) may overfit spurious background correlations for minority categories [ 67 ] .

blocks.en: Spectral bias and low-rank learning dynamics. Under gradient descent, deep networks exhibit spectral bias, favoring directions with larger singular values [ 2 ] . Let a k ​ ( t ) a_{k}(t) denote the alignment of the model with the k k -th spectral component. Its evolution approximately follows: d d ​ t ​ a k ​ ( t ) ∝ σ k 2 ​ a k ​ ( t ) , \frac{d}{dt}a_{k}(t)\propto\sigma_{k}^{2}a_{k}(t), (17) which leads to exponentially faster growth along dominant directions. Empirically, deep representations exhibit low-rank structures during training [ 7 ] , meaning that most energy concentrates in a few principal components. Background features, due to spatial redundancy and shared patterns across samples, naturally form a low-rank structure with dominant singular values. In contrast, foreground features are more diverse and distributed across many weaker components. As a result, gradient descent preferentially fits background-related components early in training, establishing an inherent optimization bias toward low-rank structures.

blocks.en: Effect of sample size on effective rank. For class y y , the effective rank of foreground features depends on the sample size N y N_{y} . When N y N_{y} is large (head classes), diverse foreground patterns are observed, allowing multiple spectral components of f fg f_{\mathrm{fg}} to be learned. blocks.en: In long-tailed visual recognition, models tend to overfit to background feature, particularly for tail classes. Addressing this optimization-level bias typically requires extra modules. However, introducing learnable parameters often exacerbates class imbalance due to biased gradient updates. To rectify this without additional parameters, we propose estimating the inherent foreground distinctiveness of each neuron based on its feature statistics. Inspired by the energy-based local spatial formulation in SimAM [ 96 ] , we hypothesize that target-related foreground features exhibit distinctive activation patterns compared to the widely distributed, background feature. To quantify this foreground distinctiveness, we measure the linear separability between the target neuron F d , u F_{d,u} and the remaining background neurons F d , v F_{d,v} ( v ≠ u v\neq u ). Additionally, we emphasize a fundamental distinction from conventional attention modules [ 99 , 30 ] regarding gradient bias and parameterization . Standard attention modules rely on learnable parameters to generate dynamic scores. Under severe long-tailed imbalance, the gradient updates for these parameters are overwhelmingly dominated by head classes. Consequently, to minimize the overall empirical risk, these modules inevitably learn to attend to and universally amplify spurious head-class backgrounds, inadvertently acting as “bias amplifiers” In contrast, our approach derives S d , u S_{d,u} purely from the intrinsic spatial statistics of the feature map, rendering it strictly parameter-free and immune to class-imbalanced gradient domination. By aggregating these statistical scores into a deterministic background penalty map B u B_{u} (Eq. 7 ), our BFR module shifts from generic feature reweighting to explicit spatial decoupling. It mathematically penalizes spurious background-foreground co-occurrences (Eq. 9 ), preventing tail-class representations from collapsing into dominant background features.

blocks.en: To further support the analysis in Sec. 5.3 , we provide extended attention-map visualizations for representative head, medium, and tail classes. As shown in Fig. 4 , we compare CE, CE+OFBD, BCL, and BCL+OFBD using pretrained-CAM attention maps. blocks.en: We further study the effect of the candidate pool size K K in FG-CutMix, where K K denotes the number of selected foreground candidates used for reward comparison and relative-advantage estimation. blocks.en: Based on the observed optimization-level bias, we further examine whether BFR can suppress the increase of the background gradient ratio. blocks.en: As shown in Table 12 , both FG-CutMix and BFR substantially reduce the background gradient ratio compared with standard CE, with the effect most pronounced for Few-shot classes. FG-CutMix decreases the gradient shift at the input level by diversifying backgrounds, while BFR further down-weights background-biased spatial features during feature-level rectification. The full OFBD, combining FG-CutMix and BFR, achieves the largest reduction across all class groups, demonstrating the complementarity between input-level background diversification and feature-level rectification in mitigating background-driven optimization.
blocks.zh: 如表12所示,与标准CE相比,FG-CutMix和BFR都大幅降低了背景梯度比,效果最显著的是几发类. FG-CutMix通过使背景多样化来降低输入级的梯度变化,而BFR则在地物级校正时会进一步降低重量背景偏差空间特征. 将FG-CutMix和BFR相结合的全OFBD实现了所有类组中最大的削减,显示了投入级背景多样化与特征级校正在缓解背景驱动优化中的互补性.

blocks.en: D.6 Performance Analysis under Long-tailed and Balanced Settings
blocks.zh: D.6 长期和平衡设置下的绩效分析

blocks.en: We further compare the head-, medium-, and tail-class performance to examine where OFBD brings the largest improvement. As shown in Fig. 8 , adding OFBD to BCL substantially improves Few-shot accuracy from 32.9 % 32.9\% to 40.2 % 40.2\% , yielding a + 7.3 % +7.3\% gain. Meanwhile, it slightly improves Medium-shot accuracy from 53.1 % 53.1\% to 53.6 % 53.6\% , with only a marginal change on Head classes from 66.9 % 66.9\% to 66.5 % 66.5\% . These results indicate that OFBD mainly benefits data-scarce tail classes while largely preserving head-class performance, demonstrating its effectiveness in alleviating tail-specific background bias.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步比较头-中-和尾-级的性能,以检查OFBD带来最大改进的地方. 如图8所示,在BCL中添加OFBD可大大地改进了几发精度,从32.9%的32.9%%到40.2%的40.2%,得出+7.3%+7.3%的增益。 同时,中射精度也略有提高,从53.1% 53.1% 提高到53.6% 53.6% 53.6% ,头等课程的边际变化由66.9% 66.9% 提高到66.5% 66.5% . 这些结果显示,OFBD主要有利于数据紧缺尾巴分类,同时在很大程度上保持了头级性能,显示出其能有效缓解尾巴特有的背景偏差.

blocks.en: We also examine whether OFBD is effective under the balanced setting, where the imbalance ratio is 1 1 . As shown in Fig. 8 , OFBD consistently improves the baseline without OFBD on balanced CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet, with gains of + 1.4 % +1.4\% , + 2.1 % +2.1\% , and + 2.1 % +2.1\% , respectively. This demonstrates that OFBD does not rely on long-tailed class distributions and can still provide object-focused regularization benefits when the class distribution is uniform.

blocks.en: D.7 Further Ablation of FG-CutMix
blocks.zh: D.7 进一步利用FG-CutMix

blocks.en: Table 4 shows that FG-CutMix with RL-based foreground selection outperforms standard CutMix with random selection. To further analyze this improvement, we compare their optimization-level background bias by measuring the background-gradient-ratio shift on CIFAR-100-LT with imbalance ratio 100 100 . As shown in Fig. 9(a) , both CutMix and FG-CutMix keep the head-class shift relatively small, suggesting that head-class optimization is less sensitive to region selection.
blocks.zh: 表4显示FG-CutMix具有基于RL的前景选择优于标准CutMix,随机选择. 为了进一步分析这一改进,我们通过测量CIFAR-100-LT上的背景-梯度-梯度变化与100-100的不平衡比来比较其优化级背景偏差。 如图9(a)所示,CutMix和FG-CutMix都保持了相对较小的头等班次,说明头等班次优化对区域选择的敏感度较低.

blocks.en: For tail classes, however, standard CutMix exhibits a stronger background-gradient-ratio shift, indicating that random replacement may preserve background cues or discard target-related foreground evidence. In contrast, FG-CutMix consistently produces a lower tail-class shift during training. This confirms that RL-based foreground region selection not only improves accuracy, as shown in Table 4 , but also reduces background-driven optimization for tail classes.
blocks.zh: 然而,对于尾巴类,标准CutMix显示出更强的背景-梯度-ratio转变,表明随机替换可能保留背景提示或丢弃与目标相关的前地证据. 相形之下,FG-CutMix在训练期间持续产生更低的尾班班. 这证实了基于RL的前景区域选择不仅能提高准确性,如表4所显示,而且降低了尾等的背景驱动优化.

blocks.en: We further examine the training stability of the RL-based foreground selector. As shown in Fig. 9(b) , the selector loss exhibits stochastic fluctuations due to random proposal sampling and policy-gradient optimization, but remains bounded and gradually stabilizes throughout training. This suggests that the selector does not suffer from unstable policy updates. Together with the accuracy improvement in Table 4 and the reduced tail-class background-gradient shift in Fig. 9(a) , these results indicate that the RL-based selector can be optimized stably while learning foreground regions that better mitigate background-driven optimization.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查基于RL的前地选择器的培训稳定性。 如图9(b)所示,由于随机抽取建议和优化政策,选取者的损失呈现出扭曲起伏,但仍有限制,并在整个培训过程中逐渐稳定下来。 这表明选择者不会受到不稳定的政策更新的影响. 加上表4中的精度提高和图9(a)中尾等背景分级变化的减少,这些结果表明,基于RL的选取器在学习更能缓解背景驱动优化的前地区域的同时,可以被用入入入入入入入入入出.

blocks.en: D.8 Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: D.8 效率分析

blocks.en: We evaluate the efficiency-accuracy trade-off of BCL+OFBD on CIFAR-100-LT with imbalance ratio 100. As shown in Fig. 6(b) , BCL+OFBD achieves the highest accuracy while maintaining a low per-epoch training cost. In particular, compared with MKP, BCL+OFBD reduces the computation cost by 2.66 2.66 seconds per epoch and improves Top-1 accuracy by 1.0 % 1.0\% . These results show that OFBD provides an efficient plug-in solution for long-tailed recognition, benefiting from its lightweight background-aware feature rectification and training-only foreground-guided augmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价BCL+OFBD在CIFAR-100-LT上的效率与准确性之间的取舍。 如图6(b)所示,BCL+OFBD在保持每个时代较低的培训费用的同时,实现了最高的精度. 特别是,与MKP相比,BCL+OFBD将计算成本每个时代降低2.66 2.66秒,并提升了Top-1的精度为1.0%. 这些结果表明,OFBD为长尾识别提供了高效的插接解决方案,得益于其轻量级背景感知特性的校正和只培训前地导增强.

blocks.en: This section presents additional results on the eigen spectral density of the Hessian for ResNet models trained with CE, BCL, and BCL+OFBD on CIFAR-100-LT. As shown in Fig. 10 , we separately analyze the Hessian spectra of head and tail classes. A smaller largest eigenvalue λ max \lambda_{\max} and trace Tr ⁡ ( H ) \mathrm{Tr}(H) generally indicate a flatter loss landscape and better optimization stability.

blocks.en: Compared with the CE baseline, BCL tends to reduce the sharpness of the loss landscape to some extent, especially for tail classes, suggesting that contrastive learning helps improve the optimization behavior under long-tailed distributions. However, its Hessian spectrum still shows relatively large eigenvalues, indicating that the optimization landscape remains sharp for certain class groups. In contrast, BCL+OFBD consistently produces lower λ max \lambda_{\max} and Tr ⁡ ( H ) \mathrm{Tr}(H) for both head and tail classes. This suggests that BCL+OFBD effectively smooths the loss landscape, rather than only benefiting tail classes. The flatter Hessian spectrum further supports that BCL+OFBD mitigates background-biased optimization and leads to more stable learning under long-tailed training.
blocks.zh: 与CE基线相比,BCL倾向于在一定程度上降低损失地貌的锐度,特别是尾等,这表明对比性学习有助于改善长尾分布下的优化行为. 然而,它的黑森光谱仍然显示出相对较大的等元值,表明优化地貌对于某些阶级群体来说仍然是尖锐的. 相形之下, BCL+OFBD 持续生成下 QQ 最大\ lambda\ max} 和 Tr → (H )\ mathrm{Tr} (H ) 两个头级和尾级. 这表明BCL+OFBD有效平整了损失地貌,而不只是有利于尾等. 受宠若惊的黑森光谱进一步支持BCL+OFBD减轻背景偏见优化,并导致在长尾训练下更稳定的学习.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitation
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: A key consideration of OFBD lies in its reliance on accurate foreground localization and feature separation. While our current FG-CutMix and BFR designs work effectively on standard visual benchmarks, scenarios with severe occlusion, extremely small objects, or highly entangled foreground-background cues may benefit from enhanced region selection strategies or adaptive rectification. Addressing these cases represents a natural direction for extending OFBD, highlighting opportunities for future work without undermining its demonstrated effectiveness on long-tailed datasets.
blocks.zh: 对OFBD的一个关键考虑在于它依赖于准确的前地定位和特征分离. 虽然我们目前的FG-CutMix和BFR设计在标准视觉基准上有效工作,但具有严重隐蔽、极小物体或高度缠绕的前地-后地提示的情景可能得益于强化的区域选择战略或适应性矫正。 处理这些案件是扩大海外生物量的自然取向,突出了未来工作的机会,同时又不损害其在长尾数据集方面表现出的实效。
